# Marco D'Antonio — Portfolio & personAI

> One-page portfolio and AI assistant for Marco D'Antonio, full-stack developer & AI engineer.
> Built with Astro 7, React, Tailwind v4, Three.js, Rapier, GSAP, Howler, and Cloudflare Workers AI.
> Cloudflare adapter configured; local implementation is not proof of deployment.

## Architecture

Two locale routes: `/` (Italian) and `/en` (English). A tropical exploration game
shares accessible content panels with direct reading. Hashes `#about`, `#education`,
`#skills`, `#projects`, `#experience`, and `#contact` open panels, not scroll scenes.

Server routes include `/api/personai` (the real RAG chat endpoint) and `/cv/[lang]`
(localized CV). `/.well-known/api-catalog` and `/docs/api` expose API discovery.
Browser tools are `scroll_to_section` (opens island content; `top` opens the map),
`open_marco_ai`, `download_cv`, and `copy_email`.

## Key conventions

- One-page game: `src/pages/index.astro` and `src/pages/en.astro` share `components/portfolio-app.tsx`; reader content uses SpotlightSection + Container
- All UI text in `content/i18n.ts` (bilingual IT/EN dictionary)
- `/en` is the English locale route; toggles should navigate the URL, not only state
- The game is not scroll-driven; any future scroll-linked effect must use `lib/scroll-signal`
- Reuse `components/system/*` before writing custom layout wrappers
- Reuse `components/ui/*` before styling raw markup
- Never reintroduce `.surface-card`, `.section-copy`, `.eyebrow` legacy helpers
- Run `npm run lint && npm run build` before considering work complete
